messages:
cheng: Heads-up — reproducible tiny token mismatch when resuming from KV after ~65k tokens on the quantized candidate. Fingerprint (sha1 of logits) changes by 1e-6 and a single token flips.

maria: Can you paste the minimal repro steps? Is this on dedicated or local stage? :eyes:

cheng: Local stage (containerized). Quick repro: run generator with longcontext=131072, use model build `cat-1024-q8` from branch `quant/edge-v2`. Steps:

```
# start server with longctx and persistent kv
./serve --model cat-1024-q8 --longcontext 131072 --kv-persist=on --wrap_mode=auto --seed=42
# prime with a 70k token prefix (script attached)
python tests/longprime.py --tokens 70000 --out primed.json
# checkpoint, restart server, then continue generation from token 65000
./checkpoint --save ckpt1
./serve --restore ckpt1
python tests/continue_gen.py --start 65000 --length 500
```

Logs show: `INFO restored kv window [0..65535]` then `WARN kv-index out-of-sync at 65536` and final token sequence differs by a single token near the boundary.

jonathan: Is this RoPE wrap vs clamp? Could be the rotary phase normalization crossing shard boundaries. Try `--wrap_mode=off` to force clamp and see. Also related to PR #4123 where we changed the prefill stride.

cheng: I tried `--wrap_mode=off`. In a subset of runs the mismatch disappears, but in runs that have repeated newline sequences around 65534..65540 it still shows up. So it's not purely wrap/clamp, seems sensitive to tokenization context across the shard handshake.

eva: Can you dump the kv keys and their token positions before/after restore and diff them? I created a tiny helper: `tools/kv_diff.py` — usage:

`python tools/kv_diff.py dump_before.pkl dump_after.pkl --show-unaligned`

Upload dumps to s3: `s3://redwood-ci/kv-dumps/2367890123/` so we can archive. If you can attach one dump here that would help.

cheng: Uploaded `kv-dump-primed.pkl` and `kv-dump-after-restore.pkl` to that bucket. Quick diff shows one KV entry shifted by 1 at logical index 4096 (shard 6). Example snippet from diff: `kv_key(4096): seq_start=65535 -> 65536` which smells like an off-by-one fencepost when merging prefill fragments.

qa-bot: CI run 236789-prod-smoke passed basic perf but failed longctx-regression (test id: longctx-236789-2). Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/ci/236789/longctx-236789-2.log.

maria: OK — plan: 1) cheng and jonathan to add a deterministic microtest that simulates fragmented prefill across two shards (incorporate newline edgecases). 2) Add assertion on kv merge that prevents seq_start regressions. 3) Run quant8 nightly on this config and post results. Timeline?

jonathan: I'll take the microtest and assertion. Suspect bug in prefill concat when prefill fragment borders aren't normalized. Will push a unit test and tentative fix in branch `eng/fencepost-kv` by EOD.

cheng: I'll run full deterministic sweep with 10 seeds and upload diffs. ETA EOD PST. If we still see flakiness we'll add an alignment normalization pass at restore time.

maria: Great. Please add reproduction snippet to the PR description and include the two kv dumps. If someone hits it earlier, @cheng please drop a short troubleshooting checklist here. :thumbsup:
